d: Yupi kangres ke navniyukt prabhari rajendr pal gautam dvara bihar aur bihariyon ko lekar die gae 'bichare bihari' vale bayan ko lekar desh aur pradesh ki rajniti puri tarah garma gaee hai. bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ne is bayan par tikhi pratikriya vyakt karte hue kangres par bihar ki asmita, svabhiman aur mehnat ka apman karne ka ganbhir aarop lagaya hai.
